annotations.title: Show business card designs to choose from

description: Show the user Designprint business card designs with their own details on them, so they can choose by looking. Use this first whenever the user asks for business cards and has not chosen a design. Ask for missing details beforehand only if you do not have their name; every other field is optional. It makes one real card per design, a set of designs at a time (front and back, 3.5 x 2 in): pass look to show only designs of one look, and page 2, 3 and so on for the next sets. It returns, for each design, its name, a one-line description, the front and back pictures and its own order link, plus a page that shows all of them and the same gallery as one self-contained HTML document. Present the result as a scrollable gallery: where the in-chat gallery is showing, point the user to it; if you can show HTML (an artifact), show the gallery document as it is; otherwise list every design with its own link and give the gallery page. Never join the designs into one picture and do not choose for the user. Then ask the user which design they like, by its name. Every change after that goes on the chosen design only, with update_business_card and that design's link; do not call show_card_designs again to add or change a detail. Once they choose, and after every change, end with "Want to change anything, or print it?"; when they say print, give that design's link: it opens the checkout page with that design, where they pick a quantity and pay as a guest. Use check_order to confirm the payment. The result also carries one link to a page with every design and the user's details already on each: give it to a user who wants to browse them all. If the user already named a design, use create_business_card instead.

accent_color.description: Hex color that replaces the design's accent, e.g. '#0E7C66'. Use the brand color if the user has one.

channel.description: Where the request comes from, e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt', 'cursor', 'terminal'.

logo_url.description: https link to a logo image (PNG, JPG or SVG). Shown on the back and small on the front. If it cannot be loaded the card is made without it and the warnings say so.

look.description: Show only designs of one look: minimal, classic, elegant, modern, bold, friendly, dark, technical. Use it when the user has said what they are after ("something dark", "keep it minimal"). Leave it out for a mix of every look.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the card.

page.description: Which set of designs to show. 1 (the default) is the first set; pass 2, then 3 and so on when the user wants to see more.

phone.description: Phone number, written the way it should print.

quantity.description: How many cards the user wants, if they said. There is a minimum order; a smaller number is raised to the minimum and the change is reported in the warnings. With a quantity, the result also gives the shipping options and an estimated total. It is preselected on the order page.

tagline.description: Short line shown under the company name on the back of the card.
